preconditions.description: The number of students n must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of top-scoring students k must be less than or equal to the total number of students n.
The lower bound l must be less than or equal to the upper bound r.
The total score of the top k students sk must be between 1 and 10^6, and the total score of all students sall must be at least sk.

postconditions.description: The sum of the printed scores must equal the total score sall.
The number of printed scores must equal the number of students n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(score) >= l and int(score) <= r for score in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All printed scores must be within the range [l, r].
The sum of the top k scores must equal sk.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"1 <= n <= 1000","description":"The number of students n must be between 1 and 1000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= k <= n","description":"The number of top-scoring students k must be less than or equal to the total number of students n."},{"id":"P3","expression":"l <= r","description":"The lower bound l must be less than or equal to the upper bound r."},{"id":"P4","expression":"1 <= sk <= sall <= 10**6","description":"The total score of the top k students sk must be between 1 and 10^6, and the total score of all students sall must be at least sk."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"sum(stdout.split()) == sall","description":"The sum of the printed scores must equal the total score sall."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"len(stdout.split()) == n","description":"The number of printed scores must equal the number of students n."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"all(int(score) >= l and int(score) <= r for score in stdout.split())","description":"All printed scores must be within the range [l, r]."},{"id":"Q4","expression":"sum(sorted(map(int, stdout.split()), reverse=True)[:k]) == sk","description":"The sum of the top k scores must equal sk."}],"invariants":[]}
